baselines.B0_full_dense: strategy=full: one full-state evolution reused across all outputs in the batch
baselines.B1_independent_cones: strategy=separate: per-request causal-cone reduction, no cross-request sharing
baselines.B2_note: Fixed ZX-then-cut pipeline: not in v1 runner scope; covered by benchmarks/run_zx.py + benchmarks/run_p4_p5.py
baselines.B3_independent_plus_dedup: Closest control for cutting families; covered by benchmarks/run_p4_p5.py (B3 vs B5)
baselines.B4_tensor: quimb/cotengra alternative; covered by benchmarks/tensor_baseline.py, not in v1 runner
baselines.B5_proposed: strategy=grouped/auto: shared identical retained circuits; auto selects among full/separate/grouped by heuristic

A_pair_controls.description: Separable baseline isolating cone extraction + grouping. m entangled pairs, 4 observables per pair (Za, Zb, ZaZb, XaXb).
A_pair_controls.overlap: identical within pair groups; disjoint across pairs

B_connected_local.ansatz: Hardware-efficient RY layers + linear CX chain; LAYERS {8: 2, 12: 3}; gates seeded RNG(seed=42+n)
B_connected_local.description: Connected local circuits where cones percolate toward full width. Framed as variational Pauli-sum (VQE-style) batches.
B_connected_local.overlap: partially overlapping cones (radius 0-2 around random center)
